source_text: 随着生活水平的提高，更多人开始加入到自驾游的行列之中。自驾游者既可驾驶自家车也可借车或 租车出游。司机可能是车主或结伴出游者。自驾游与传统的组团旅游不同，它能够更好地满足旅游者的 个性化需求，使他们更好地享受旅游的过程。自驾游尤其受到年轻出游者的欢迎。年轻人追求独立自由 的生活，而自驾游恰好满足了他们的这一需求。
reference_translation: With the improvement of living standards, more people have started to join the ranks of self-driving tours. Self-driving tourists can either drive their own cars or borrow or rent cars for trips. The driver may be the car owner or a fellow traveler. Different from traditional group tours, self-driving tours can better meet the personalized needs of tourists and enable them to better enjoy the travel process. Self-driving tours are especially popular among young travelers. Young people pursue an independent and free life, and self-driving tours just meet this need of theirs.
